# gurubadiger367-lgtm.github.io
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8"/>
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1"/>
<title>YOLO on Raspberry Pi — Intern Learning Guide | ComedKares</title>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=DM+Serif+Display:ital@0;1&family=DM+Mono:wght@400;500&family=Outfit:wght@300;400;500;600;700;800&display=swap" rel="stylesheet"/>
<style>
*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth;font-size:16px}

:root{
  --bg:#08111f;
  --bg2:#0d1a2e;
  --bg3:#112240;
  --panel:#0f1e38;
  --border:rgba(99,179,237,0.12);
  --border2:rgba(99,179,237,0.22);
  --navy:#0a1628;
  --blue:#1a56db;
  --blue2:#3b82f6;
  --sky:#63b3ed;
  --gold:#e9b84a;
  --gold2:#f6d07a;
  --amber:#fbbf24;
  --white:#f0f6ff;
  --dim:#7a94b8;
  --dim2:#4a6080;
  --green:#10b981;
  --green2:rgba(16,185,129,0.1);
  --red:#ef4444;
  --red2:rgba(239,68,68,0.1);
  --purple:#a78bfa;
  --orange:#f97316;
  --r:10px;
  --mono:'DM Mono',monospace;
  --serif:'DM Serif Display',serif;
  --sans:'Outfit',sans-serif;
}

body{
  font-family:var(--sans);
  background:var(--bg);
  color:var(--white);
  line-height:1.7;
  overflow-x:hidden;
}

/* ── PROGRESS ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
#bar{
  position:fixed;top:0;left:0;height:2px;
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--gold),var(--sky),var(--gold));
  background-size:200% auto;
  animation:shimmer 2s linear infinite;
  z-index:9999;width:0%;transition:width .08s;
}
@keyframes shimmer{to{background-position:200% center}}

/* ── TOPBAR ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
header{
  position:sticky;top:0;z-index:500;
  background:rgba(8,17,31,0.88);
  backdrop-filter:blur(16px);
  border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;
  padding:0 48px;height:56px;gap:20px;
}
.hd-left{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:20px}
.hd-left img{height:24px}
.hd-sep{width:1px;height:22px;background:var(--border2)}
.hd-title{
  font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11.5px;font-weight:500;
  color:var(--gold);letter-spacing:0.06em;white-space:nowrap;
}
nav{display:flex;gap:2px}
nav a{
  font-size:11.5px;font-weight:600;color:var(--dim);
  padding:5px 13px;border-radius:100px;
  text-decoration:none;transition:all .2s;
  white-space:nowrap;letter-spacing:0.02em;
}
nav a:hover,nav a.on{color:var(--white);background:rgba(99,179,237,0.1);color:var(--sky)}

/* ── HERO ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
.hero{
  min-height:96vh;display:flex;align-items:center;
  position:relative;overflow:hidden;
  padding:100px 80px 80px;
}
.hero-noise{
  position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;
  background-image:url("data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg viewBox='0 0 512 512' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%3E%3Cfilter id='n'%3E%3CfeTurbulence type='fractalNoise' baseFrequency='0.75' numOctaves='4' stitchTiles='stitch'/%3E%3C/filter%3E%3Crect width='100%25' height='100%25' filter='url(%23n)' opacity='0.04'/%3E%3C/svg%3E");
  opacity:.5;
}
.hero-lines{
  position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;
  background:
    radial-gradient(ellipse 80% 60% at 70% 40%, rgba(26,86,219,0.14), transparent 60%),
    radial-gradient(ellipse 60% 60% at 20% 80%, rgba(233,184,74,0.06), transparent 50%);
}
.hero-grid{
  position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;
  background-image:
    linear-gradient(rgba(99,179,237,0.04) 1px,transparent 1px),
    linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(99,179,237,0.04) 1px,transparent 1px);
  background-size:72px 72px;
}
.hero-content{
  position:relative;z-index:2;max-width:760px;
}
.hero-eyebrow{
  display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;
  background:rgba(233,184,74,0.08);
  border:1px solid rgba(233,184,74,0.25);
  border-radius:100px;padding:7px 20px;margin-bottom:36px;
  font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11px;font-weight:500;
  color:var(--gold);letter-spacing:0.08em;text-transform:uppercase;
  animation:fadeSlide .5s ease both;
}
.pulse{
  width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--gold);
  animation:pop 1.8s ease-in-out infinite;
}
@keyframes pop{0%,100%{transform:scale(1);opacity:1}50%{transform:scale(.7);opacity:.5}}

.hero h1{
  font-family:var(--serif);
  font-size:clamp(44px,7vw,82px);
  line-height:1.06;color:var(--white);
  margin-bottom:10px;letter-spacing:-0.01em;
  animation:fadeSlide .55s ease .08s both;
}
.hero h1 em{color:var(--gold);font-style:italic}
.hero h1 span{
  color:transparent;
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--sky),var(--blue2));
  -webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;
}
.hero-sub{
  font-size:17px;color:var(--dim);line-height:1.8;
  max-width:580px;margin-bottom:44px;
  animation:fadeSlide .55s ease .16s both;
}
.hero-chips{
  display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:9px;margin-bottom:52px;
  animation:fadeSlide .55s ease .22s both;
}
.chip{
  font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11px;font-weight:500;
  padding:5px 14px;border-radius:100px;
  border:1px solid;letter-spacing:0.04em;
}
.chip-b{color:#93c5fd;border-color:rgba(147,197,253,.25);background:rgba(147,197,253,.06)}
.chip-g{color:#6ee7b7;border-color:rgba(110,231,183,.22);background:rgba(110,231,183,.05)}
.chip-o{color:var(--gold2);border-color:rgba(246,208,122,.22);background:rgba(246,208,122,.05)}
.chip-p{color:#c4b5fd;border-color:rgba(196,181,253,.22);background:rgba(196,181,253,.05)}
.chip-r{color:#fca5a5;border-color:rgba(252,165,165,.22);background:rgba(252,165,165,.05)}

.hero-stat-row{
  display:flex;gap:0;border:1px solid var(--border2);
  border-radius:14px;overflow:hidden;
  max-width:520px;
  animation:fadeSlide .55s ease .28s both;
}
.h-stat{
  flex:1;padding:18px 20px;text-align:center;
  border-right:1px solid var(--border);
  background:rgba(255,255,255,0.02);
}
.h-stat:last-child{border-right:none}
.h-stat-n{
  font-family:var(--serif);font-size:30px;
  color:var(--gold);line-height:1;
}
.h-stat-l{
  font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10px;
  color:var(--dim2);text-transform:uppercase;
  letter-spacing:0.1em;margin-top:5px;
}

.hero-deco{
  position:absolute;right:-60px;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);
  width:480px;height:480px;
  border-radius:50%;
  background:radial-gradient(circle at 40% 40%,rgba(26,86,219,0.18),transparent 65%);
  pointer-events:none;
}

@keyframes fadeSlide{
  from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(18px)}
  to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}
}

/* ── SECTION WRAPPER ──────────────────────────────────────────────── */
.wrap{max-width:1140px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 60px}

.sec{padding:90px 0}
.sec-tag{
  font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11px;font-weight:500;
  color:var(--sky);letter-spacing:0.1em;text-transform:uppercase;
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;margin-bottom:14px;
}
.sec-tag::before{content:'';display:block;width:24px;height:1px;background:var(--sky)}
.sec-h{
  font-family:var(--serif);
  font-size:clamp(28px,4vw,44px);
  color:var(--white);margin-bottom:14px;
  letter-spacing:-0.01em;line-height:1.15;
}
.sec-lead{
  font-size:15.5px;color:var(--dim);line-height:1.85;
  max-width:640px;margin-bottom:52px;
}
.divider{
  height:1px;
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,rgba(99,179,237,0.18),transparent);
  margin:0;
}

/* ── CONCEPT CARDS ─────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
.concept-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:16px}
@media(max-width:900px){.concept-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}}
@media(max-width:600px){.concept-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}}

.ccard{
  background:var(--panel);
  border:1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius:14px;padding:26px 24px;
  position:relative;overflow:hidden;
  transition:border-color .25s,transform .25s,box-shadow .25s;
  cursor:default;
}
.ccard::before{
  content:'';position:absolute;top:0;left:0;right:0;height:2px;
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--blue),var(--sky));
  transform:scaleX(0);transform-origin:left;transition:transform .3s;
}
.ccard:hover{
  border-color:var(--border2);
  transform:translateY(-3px);
  box-shadow:0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.3);
}
.ccard:hover::before{transform:scaleX(1)}
.ccard-num{
  font-family:var(--mono);font-size:32px;font-weight:500;
  color:rgba(233,184,74,0.15);line-height:1;margin-bottom:16px;
}
.ccard-title{
  font-size:15px;font-weight:700;color:var(--white);
  margin-bottom:9px;letter-spacing:-0.01em;
}
.ccard-body{font-size:13.5px;color:var(--dim);line-height:1.8}
.ccard-body strong{color:var(--white);font-weight:600}
.ccard-body code{
  font-family:var(--mono);font-size:12px;
  background:rgba(99,179,237,0.1);color:var(--sky);
  padding:1px 6px;border-radius:4px;
}

/* ── TWO COL ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
.two{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:18px}
@media(max-width:720px){.two{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
.three{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr 1fr;gap:16px}
@media(max-width:900px){.three{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}}
@media(max-width:560px){.three{grid-template-columns:1fr}}

/* ── PANEL ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
.panel{
  background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius:14px;padding:26px 28px;
}

/* ── CALLOUTS ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
.box{
  border-radius:10px;padding:18px 22px;
  display:flex;gap:14px;align-items:flex-start;
  margin:22px 0;
}
.box-warn{background:rgba(239,68,68,.07);border:1px solid rgba(239,68,68,.22)}
.box-tip{background:rgba(16,185,129,.07);border:1px solid rgba(16,185,129,.2)}
.box-info{background:rgba(59,130,246,.07);border:1px solid rgba(59,130,246,.2)}
.box-gold{background:rgba(233,184,74,.06);border:1px solid rgba(233,184,74,.2)}
.box-purple{background:rgba(167,139,250,.06);border:1px solid rgba(167,139,250,.2)}
.box-ico{font-size:18px;flex-shrink:0;line-height:1.5}
.box-c .box-label{
  font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10.5px;font-weight:500;
  text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:0.08em;margin-bottom:5px;
}
.box-warn .box-label{color:#f87171}
.box-tip .box-label{color:#34d399}
.box-info .box-label{color:#60a5fa}
.box-gold .box-label{color:var(--gold)}
.box-purple .box-label{color:var(--purple)}
.box-c p{font-size:13.5px;color:rgba(240,246,255,.68);line-height:1.75}
.box-c p strong{color:var(--white)}
.box-c p code{
  font-family:var(--mono);font-size:12px;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.08);color:var(--sky);
  padding:1px 6px;border-radius:4px;
}

/* ── CODE ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
.code-wrap{
  background:#050d1c;
  border:1px solid rgba(99,179,237,0.15);
  border-radius:12px;overflow:hidden;margin:18px 0;
}
.code-bar{
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;
  padding:9px 16px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.03);
  border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.05);
}
.dots{display:flex;gap:5px}
.dots span{width:9px;height:9px;border-radius:50%}
.dr{background:#ff5f57}.dy{background:#ffbd2e}.dg{background:#28ca40}
.code-file{
  font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11px;
  color:rgba(255,255,255,.3);
}
.cpbtn{
  font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10.5px;color:var(--dim);
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.05);border:none;
  border-radius:5px;padding:3px 10px;cursor:pointer;transition:all .2s;
}
.cpbtn:hover{background:rgba(233,184,74,.12);color:var(--gold)}
.code-body{padding:18px 20px;overflow-x:auto}
pre{
  font-family:var(--mono);font-size:13px;
  line-height:1.75;white-space:pre;
}
.cm{color:#4a6080}.kw{color:#ff7b72}.st{color:#a5f3fc}
.fn{color:#c9a5fa}.va{color:#ffa657}.co{color:#7ee787}
.nu{color:#f6d07a}.op{color:#c8d3e0}.de{color:var(--sky)}

/* ── TABLE ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
.tbl{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:13.5px;margin:16px 0}
.tbl th{
  background:rgba(26,86,219,0.25);color:var(--white);
  padding:10px 14px;text-align:left;
  font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11px;font-weight:500;
  letter-spacing:0.06em;text-transform:uppercase;
  border:1px solid rgba(99,179,237,0.15);
}
.tbl td{
  padding:9px 14px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.06);
  color:var(--dim);line-height:1.65;vertical-align:top;
}
.tbl tr:hover td{background:rgba(255,255,255,.02)}
.tbl td:first-child{color:var(--white);font-weight:600}
.tbl td code,.tbl th code{
  font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11.5px;
  background:rgba(99,179,237,.12);color:var(--sky);
  padding:1px 6px;border-radius:4px;
}

/* ── STEPS ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
.steps{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:0;margin-top:8px}
.step{display:flex;gap:0;position:relative}
.step:not(:last-child)::after{
  content:'';position:absolute;
  left:22px;top:48px;bottom:0;
  width:1px;background:rgba(233,184,74,.12);z-index:0;
}
.s-circle{
  width:46px;flex-shrink:0;
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;
  padding-top:2px;
}
.s-num{
  width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:11px;
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--blue) 0%,var(--blue2) 100%);
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  font-family:var(--mono);font-size:15px;font-weight:500;
  color:var(--white);flex-shrink:0;z-index:1;
  box-shadow:0 0 24px rgba(26,86,219,.4);
}
.s-body{flex:1;padding:2px 0 44px 24px}
.s-title{
  font-size:17px;font-weight:700;color:var(--white);
  margin-bottom:8px;letter-spacing:-0.01em;
}
.s-desc{font-size:14px;color:var(--dim);line-height:1.8;margin-bottom:12px}

/* ── PERF BARS ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
.pbar-row{margin-bottom:20px}
.pbar-meta{
  display:flex;justify-content:space-between;
  margin-bottom:6px;font-size:13px;
}
.pbar-name{font-weight:600;color:var(--white)}
.pbar-val{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:12px;color:var(--gold)}
.pbar-track{
  height:8px;border-radius:100px;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);overflow:hidden;
}
.pbar-fill{height:100%;border-radius:100px}
.pbar-sub{font-size:12px;color:var(--dim2);margin-top:4px}

/* ── ACCORDION ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
.acc-item{
  border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:10px;
  margin-bottom:7px;overflow:hidden;
}
.acc-hd{
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;
  padding:14px 18px;cursor:pointer;gap:12px;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.025);
  transition:background .2s;
}
.acc-hd:hover{background:rgba(99,179,237,.06)}
.acc-err{
  font-family:var(--mono);font-size:13px;font-weight:500;
  color:#f87171;flex:1;
}
.acc-arrow{color:var(--dim2);transition:transform .28s;font-size:12px}
.acc-item.open .acc-arrow{transform:rotate(180deg)}
.acc-bd{
  max-height:0;overflow:hidden;
  transition:max-height .38s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1),padding .3s;
  padding:0 18px;
}
.acc-item.open .acc-bd{max-height:420px;padding:4px 18px 20px}
.acc-cause{
  font-size:13.5px;color:var(--dim);line-height:1.75;margin-bottom:10px;
}
.acc-fix{
  background:rgba(16,185,129,.07);border:1px solid rgba(16,185,129,.18);
  border-radius:8px;padding:10px 14px;
  font-size:13px;color:#6ee7b7;line-height:1.75;
}
.acc-fix code{
  font-family:var(--mono);font-size:12px;
  background:rgba(16,185,129,.1);color:#34d399;
  padding:1px 6px;border-radius:4px;
}

/* ── COCO PILLS ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
.coco-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(220px,1fr));gap:12px}
.coco-card{
  background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius:10px;padding:18px 20px;
  transition:border-color .2s;
}
.coco-card:hover{border-color:var(--border2)}
.coco-ico{font-size:22px;margin-bottom:9px}
.coco-title{font-size:13px;font-weight:700;color:var(--white);margin-bottom:7px}
.coco-list{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--dim);line-height:1.8}

/* ── CHECKLIST ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
.cklist{list-style:none;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px}
.cklist li{
  display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:12px;
  padding:11px 14px;border-radius:8px;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.025);
  border:1px solid var(--border);
  cursor:pointer;transition:all .2s;
  font-size:13.5px;color:rgba(240,246,255,.7);line-height:1.5;
}
.cklist li:hover{background:rgba(16,185,129,.06);border-color:rgba(16,185,129,.2)}
.cklist li.done{
  background:rgba(16,185,129,.07);
  border-color:rgba(16,185,129,.22);
  color:rgba(240,246,255,.38);text-decoration:line-through;
}
.ck-box{
  width:19px;height:19px;flex-shrink:0;border-radius:5px;
  border:1.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,.2);
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  transition:all .2s;margin-top:1px;font-size:10px;
}
.cklist li.done .ck-box{
  background:#10b981;border-color:#10b981;color:#fff;
}

/* ── CHALLENGES SECTION ──────────────────────────────────────────────── */
.ch-section{
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--bg) 0%,var(--bg2) 30%,var(--bg) 100%);
  border-top:1px solid var(--border);
  border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);
  position:relative;overflow:hidden;
}
.ch-section::before{
  content:'';position:absolute;
  top:-300px;right:-300px;width:700px;height:700px;
  border-radius:50%;
  background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(233,184,74,.06),transparent 60%);
  pointer-events:none;
}
.ch-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:16px}
@media(max-width:820px){.ch-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}}

.ch-card{
  background:var(--panel);
  border:1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius:14px;padding:26px 24px;
  position:relative;overflow:hidden;
  transition:all .3s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1);
}
.ch-card:hover{
  border-color:rgba(233,184,74,.3);
  transform:translateY(-4px);
  box-shadow:0 24px 56px rgba(0,0,0,.35);
  background:rgba(15,30,56,.9);
}
.ch-top{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:space-between;margin-bottom:14px}
.ch-badge{
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:8px;
  background:rgba(233,184,74,.12);
  border:1px solid rgba(233,184,74,.25);
  font-family:var(--mono);font-size:13px;font-weight:500;
  color:var(--gold);
}
.ch-diff{
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:3px;
  font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10.5px;
  color:var(--dim2);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:0.05em;
}
.star{font-size:10px;color:var(--gold)}
.star.off{color:rgba(255,255,255,.12)}
.ch-title{font-size:16px;font-weight:700;color:var(--white);margin-bottom:8px;letter-spacing:-0.01em}
.ch-desc{font-size:13.5px;color:var(--dim);line-height:1.8;margin-bottom:14px}
.ch-tags{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px;margin-bottom:14px}
.ct{
  font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10px;font-weight:500;

/* ── REF CARDS ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
.ref-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(250px,1fr));gap:12px;margin-top:20px}

  background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--border);

}

  align-self:flex-start;font-family:var(--mono);

}
.rt-doc{background:rgba(59,130,246,.12);color:#93c5fd}
.rt-tool{background:rgba(16,185,129,.1);color:#6ee7b7}

.ref-title{font-size:13.5px;font-weight:700;color:var(--white);line-height:1.3}

/* ── FOOTER ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
footer{

footer p{font-size:12px;color:var(--dim2);line-height:1.7}
</style>

<!-- ═══ SECTION 1: CONCEPTS ═══ -->
<section class="sec" id="concepts">
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="sec-tag">Topic 01</div>
    <h2 class="sec-h">Core Concepts You Must Understand</h2>
    <p class="sec-lead">Before writing a single line of code, make sure these ideas are clear. They explain <em>why</em> every command exists.</p>

    <div class="concept-grid">
      <div class="ccard">
        <div class="ccard-num">01</div>
        <div class="ccard-title">What is YOLO?</div>
        <div class="ccard-body"><strong>You Only Look Once</strong> is a real-time object detection algorithm. Unlike older detectors that scan image regions multiple times, YOLO runs the entire image through one neural network in a single forward pass and outputs all bounding boxes simultaneously. This is what makes it fast enough for live video on low-power hardware.</div>
      </div>
      <div class="ccard">
        <div class="ccard-num">02</div>
        <div class="ccard-title">What is NCNN?</div>
        <div class="ccard-body">A high-performance inference framework from Tencent, optimised for <strong>ARM processors</strong>. It fuses neural network layers, eliminates Python overhead, and uses <strong>ARM NEON intrinsics</strong> — the Pi's built-in vector instruction set — to run multiple multiply-accumulate operations in parallel. Result: 4–5× faster than PyTorch on the same hardware.</div>
      </div>
      <div class="ccard">
        <div class="ccard-num">03</div>
        <div class="ccard-title">RGB vs BGR Colour Order</div>
        <div class="ccard-body">PiCamera2 outputs frames in <strong>RGB</strong> (Red index 0, Green index 1, Blue index 2). OpenCV and YOLO expect <strong>BGR</strong> (Blue index 0) — a 35-year-old convention from early video hardware. Skipping <code>cv2.COLOR_RGB2BGR</code> gives inverted colours <strong>and</strong> silently reduces detection accuracy. Always convert.</div>
      </div>
      <div class="ccard">
        <div class="ccard-num">04</div>
        <div class="ccard-title">Confidence Threshold</div>
        <div class="ccard-body">YOLO assigns each detection a confidence score (0–1). <code>conf=0.3</code> means only show detections with ≥30% confidence. Lower → more detections, more false positives. Higher → fewer but more reliable detections. Tune based on environment: low light → 0.2, bright clear scene → 0.5+.</div>
      </div>
      <div class="ccard">
        <div class="ccard-num">05</div>
        <div class="ccard-title">--system-site-packages Flag</div>
        <div class="ccard-body">A standard venv is completely isolated from system packages. But <strong>python3-torch</strong>, <strong>python3-opencv</strong>, and <strong>python3-picamera2</strong> are installed via <code>apt</code> with ARM-optimised C extensions that pip cannot replicate. This flag lets the venv inherit those fast system packages while still isolating pip installs.</div>
      </div>
      <div class="ccard">
        <div class="ccard-num">06</div>
        <div class="ccard-title">Wall-Clock FPS</div>
        <div class="ccard-body">FPS = frames processed per second, calculated as <code>1 ÷ (now − last_frame_time)</code>. This is <strong>wall-clock FPS</strong> — it includes camera capture, inference, drawing, and display. It's the most honest performance metric because it measures every bottleneck your user actually experiences.</div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="box box-info" style="margin-top:32px">
      <div class="box-ico">💡</div>
      <div class="box-c">
        <div class="box-label">Why NCNN and not TensorFlow Lite?</div>
        <p>TFLite gives ~3–4 FPS on RPi 4. NCNN gives 4–5 FPS. Both export via Ultralytics, but NCNN's integration is seamless — one command to export, one line to load. For this course, NCNN is the recommended path. Challenge 5 asks you to benchmark and compare the two yourself.</p>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<div class="divider"></div>

<!-- ═══ SECTION 2: ARCHITECTURE ═══ -->
<section class="sec" id="arch">
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="sec-tag">Topic 02</div>
    <h2 class="sec-h">YOLO11n Architecture</h2>
    <p class="sec-lead">Understanding what's inside the model lets you debug, tune, and extend it with confidence.</p>

    <table class="tbl">
      <thead><tr><th>Component</th><th>Role</th><th>Why It Matters for You</th></tr></thead>
      <tbody>
        <tr><td>Backbone (CSPNet)</td><td>Extracts features — edges, textures, shapes — at multiple scales</td><td>Detects small bottles far away AND large people close up in the same pass</td></tr>
        <tr><td>Neck (PAN-FPN)</td><td>Path Aggregation Network — fuses feature maps from different backbone depths</td><td>Combines fine detail from shallow layers with semantic context from deep layers</td></tr>
        <tr><td>Head (×3 scales)</td><td>Three decoupled detection heads: 8 px grid, 16 px grid, 32 px grid</td><td>Separate heads for small / medium / large objects simultaneously</td></tr>
        <tr><td>Input format</td><td>640×640 letterboxed, normalised 0–1, BGR channel order</td><td>Always pass <code>imgsz=640</code> — mismatch degrades accuracy</td></tr>
        <tr><td>Output per box</td><td>x, y, w, h + confidence + 80 class probabilities</td><td>NMS filters overlapping boxes; <code>conf</code> threshold filters low-confidence ones</td></tr>
        <tr><td>~2.6 M parameters</td><td>Nano model — smallest in the YOLO11 family</td><td>Trades some accuracy for the speed embedded hardware needs</td></tr>
      </tbody>
    </table>

    <div class="box box-gold" style="margin-top:24px">
      <div class="box-ico">⚡</div>
      <div class="box-c">
        <div class="box-label">NCNN Layer Fusion — Where the Speedup Comes From</div>
        <p>In PyTorch, <strong>Conv → BatchNorm → ReLU</strong> run as three separate operations: three memory passes, three Python calls, three GIL acquisitions. NCNN's compiler fuses them into <strong>one fused operator</strong> — one memory pass, zero Python overhead. Multiply this across hundreds of layers and you understand where the 4–5× speedup comes from.</p>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="two" style="margin-top:32px">
      <div class="panel">
        <div style="font-size:15px;font-weight:700;color:var(--white);margin-bottom:16px">Model Format Comparison · RPi 4</div>
        <table class="tbl">
          <thead><tr><th>Format</th><th>FPS</th><th>RAM</th></tr></thead>
          <tbody>
            <tr><td>.pt (PyTorch)</td><td>&lt;1 FPS</td><td>~600 MB</td></tr>
            <tr><td>.onnx</td><td>1–2 FPS</td><td>~250 MB</td></tr>
            <tr><td>.tflite</td><td>3–4 FPS</td><td>~70 MB</td></tr>
            <tr><td><strong>.ncnn ✓</strong></td><td><strong>4–5 FPS</strong></td><td><strong>~80 MB</strong></td></tr>
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>
      <div class="panel">
        <div style="font-size:15px;font-weight:700;color:var(--white);margin-bottom:16px">NCNN Model Files Explained</div>
        <div style="font-size:13.5px;color:var(--dim);line-height:1.9">
          <p style="margin-bottom:10px"><strong style="color:var(--white)">model.ncnn.bin</strong> (~6 MB)<br/>Binary weight tensors — all learned values from COCO training.</p>
          <p style="margin-bottom:10px"><strong style="color:var(--white)">model.ncnn.param</strong> (~30 KB)<br/>Network topology in human-readable text. Open it with <code style="font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11.5px;background:rgba(99,179,237,.1);color:var(--sky);padding:1px 6px;border-radius:4px">cat model.ncnn.param | head -20</code> to see every layer!</p>
          <p><strong style="color:var(--white)">metadata.yaml</strong> (~2 KB)<br/>Maps class IDs 0–79 to names. Class 0 = person, 39 = bottle, 63 = laptop.</p>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<div class="divider"></div>

<!-- ═══ SECTION 3: SETUP ═══ -->
<section class="sec" id="setup">
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="sec-tag">Topic 03</div>
    <h2 class="sec-h">Complete Environment Setup</h2>
    <p class="sec-lead">Every command explained. Follow in order — skipping steps causes errors that are very hard to debug later.</p>

    <div class="steps">

      <div class="step">
        <div class="s-circle"><div class="s-num">1</div></div>
        <div class="s-body">
          <div class="s-title">Update System Packages</div>
          <div class="s-desc">The camera stack (libcamera) updates often. Outdated libraries cause ABI mismatches — cryptic C-level crashes nearly impossible to debug in Python.</div>
          <div class="code-wrap">
            <div class="code-bar"><div class="dots"><span class="dr"></span><span class="dy"></span><span class="dg"></span></div><span class="code-file">terminal</span><button class="cpbtn" onclick="copyCode(this)">copy</button></div>
            <div class="code-body"><pre><span class="cm">$</span> <span class="kw">sudo</span> apt update
<span class="cm">$</span> <span class="kw">sudo</span> apt upgrade -y
<span class="cm">$</span> <span class="kw">sudo</span> reboot  <span class="cm"># only if a kernel update was installed</span></pre></div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="step">
        <div class="s-circle"><div class="s-num">2</div></div>
        <div class="s-body">
          <div class="s-title">Install ARM-Optimised System Packages</div>
          <div class="s-desc">These <strong>must</strong> come from <code>apt</code>, not pip. The pip equivalents are x86-compiled — 4–10× slower on ARM, and picamera2 cannot be pip-installed at all.</div>
          <div class="code-wrap">
            <div class="code-bar"><div class="dots"><span class="dr"></span><span class="dy"></span><span class="dg"></span></div><span class="code-file">terminal</span><button class="cpbtn" onclick="copyCode(this)">copy</button></div>
            <div class="code-body"><pre><span class="cm">$</span> <span class="kw">sudo</span> apt install -y <span class="va">\</span>
    python3-opencv <span class="va">\</span>
    python3-torch  <span class="va">\</span>
    python3-torchvision <span class="va">\</span>
    python3-picamera2 <span class="va">\</span>
    libcamera-tools <span class="va">\</span>
    python3-pip python3-venv</pre></div>
          </div>
          <div class="box box-warn" style="margin-top:10px">
            <div class="box-ico">🚫</div>
            <div class="box-c">
              <div class="box-label">Never do this</div>
              <p><code>pip install torch</code> · <code>pip install opencv-python</code> · <code>pip install picamera2</code> — these will either fail or install slow, incompatible versions. ARM-optimised builds only exist via <code>apt</code> on Raspberry Pi OS Bookworm.</p>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="step">
        <div class="s-circle"><div class="s-num">3</div></div>
        <div class="s-body">
          <div class="s-title">Verify Camera Hardware</div>
          <div class="s-desc">Always test hardware before writing code. If the camera fails here, no Python code will fix it.</div>
          <div class="code-wrap">
            <div class="code-bar"><div class="dots"><span class="dr"></span><span class="dy"></span><span class="dg"></span></div><span class="code-file">terminal</span><button class="cpbtn" onclick="copyCode(this)">copy</button></div>
            <div class="code-body"><pre><span class="cm">$</span> rpicam-hello
<span class="cm">
# Expected:</span>
<span class="co">libcamera v0.x</span>
<span class="co">Registered camera ov5647</span>
<span class="cm"># → A 5-second preview window opens</span></pre></div>
          </div>
          <div class="box box-warn" style="margin-top:10px">
            <div class="box-ico">⚠️</div>
            <div class="box-c">
              <div class="box-label">Camera not detected?</div>
              <p>Power OFF the Pi completely. Re-seat the ribbon cable — <strong>silver contacts must face the HDMI port</strong>. Never hot-plug the camera cable while powered on — you can permanently destroy the CSI port.</p>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="step">
        <div class="s-circle"><div class="s-num">4</div></div>
        <div class="s-body">
          <div class="s-title">Create Project Directory</div>
          <div class="code-wrap">
            <div class="code-bar"><div class="dots"><span class="dr"></span><span class="dy"></span><span class="dg"></span></div><span class="code-file">terminal</span><button class="cpbtn" onclick="copyCode(this)">copy</button></div>
            <div class="code-body"><pre><span class="cm">$</span> mkdir ~/yolo &amp;&amp; cd ~/yolo &amp;&amp; pwd
<span class="co">/home/pi/yolo</span></pre></div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="step">
        <div class="s-circle"><div class="s-num">5</div></div>
        <div class="s-body">
          <div class="s-title">Create Virtual Environment with --system-site-packages</div>
          <div class="s-desc">The most important single command. Without this flag, the venv cannot see the ARM-optimised apt packages and everything breaks.</div>
          <div class="code-wrap">
            <div class="code-bar"><div class="dots"><span class="dr"></span><span class="dy"></span><span class="dg"></span></div><span class="code-file">terminal</span><button class="cpbtn" onclick="copyCode(this)">copy</button></div>
            <div class="code-body"><pre><span class="cm">$</span> python3 -m venv <span class="kw">--system-site-packages</span> venv
<span class="cm">$</span> <span class="kw">source</span> venv/bin/activate
<span class="cm">
# Prompt now shows (venv) — confirm it's active</span>
<span class="co">(venv) pi@raspberrypi:~/yolo $</span>
<span class="cm">
# Verify system packages are visible:</span>
<span class="cm">$</span> python3 -c <span class="st">"import cv2; print('OpenCV:', cv2.__version__)"</span>
<span class="cm">$</span> python3 -c <span class="st">"from picamera2 import Picamera2; print('PiCamera2: OK')"</span>
<span class="cm">$</span> python3 -c <span class="st">"import torch; print('PyTorch:', torch.__version__)"</span></pre></div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="step">
        <div class="s-circle"><div class="s-num">6</div></div>
        <div class="s-body">
          <div class="s-title">Install YOLO Framework via pip</div>
          <div class="code-wrap">
            <div class="code-bar"><div class="dots"><span class="dr"></span><span class="dy"></span><span class="dg"></span></div><span class="code-file">terminal</span><button class="cpbtn" onclick="copyCode(this)">copy</button></div>
            <div class="code-body"><pre><span class="cm">$</span> pip install --upgrade pip
<span class="cm">$</span> pip install ultralytics ncnn
<span class="cm">$</span> pip install numpy matplotlib scipy pyyaml tqdm
<span class="cm">
# Confirm install:</span>
<span class="cm">$</span> python3 -c <span class="st">"from ultralytics import YOLO; print('Ultralytics: OK')"</span></pre></div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="step">
        <div class="s-circle"><div class="s-num">7</div></div>
        <div class="s-body">
          <div class="s-title">Download Pretrained YOLO11n Model</div>
          <div class="code-wrap">
            <div class="code-bar"><div class="dots"><span class="dr"></span><span class="dy"></span><span class="dg"></span></div><span class="code-file">terminal</span><button class="cpbtn" onclick="copyCode(this)">copy</button></div>
            <div class="code-body"><pre><span class="cm">$</span> wget https://github.com/ultralytics/assets/releases/download/v8.3.0/yolo11n.pt
<span class="cm">$</span> ls
<span class="co">yolo11n.pt  venv</span></pre></div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="step">
        <div class="s-circle"><div class="s-num">8</div></div>
        <div class="s-body">
          <div class="s-title">Convert to NCNN Format (2–4 minutes)</div>
          <div class="s-desc">This is the performance conversion — fuses layers, removes Python overhead, generates ARM Neon code. Takes a few minutes. Do not interrupt.</div>
          <div class="code-wrap">
            <div class="code-bar"><div class="dots"><span class="dr"></span><span class="dy"></span><span class="dg"></span></div><span class="code-file">terminal</span><button class="cpbtn" onclick="copyCode(this)">copy</button></div>
            <div class="code-body"><pre><span class="cm">$</span> yolo export model=yolo11n.pt format=ncnn
<span class="cm">
# Verify the output folder:</span>
<span class="cm">$</span> ls yolo11n_ncnn_model
<span class="co">model.ncnn.bin  model.ncnn.param  metadata.yaml</span></pre></div>
          </div>
          <div class="box box-tip" style="margin-top:10px">
            <div class="box-ico">🔎</div>
            <div class="box-c">
              <div class="box-label">Curious what's inside the param file?</div>
              <p>Run <code>cat yolo11n_ncnn_model/model.ncnn.param | head -30</code> — you'll see every fused layer listed in human-readable format. This is the complete neural network topology after NCNN optimisation.</p>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<div class="divider"></div>

<!-- ═══ SECTION 4: CODE ═══ -->
<section class="sec" id="code">
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="sec-tag">Topic 04</div>
    <h2 class="sec-h">Detection Script — Every Line Explained</h2>
    <p class="sec-lead">Don't just run this — understand what each part does and why it's there.</p>

    <div class="code-wrap">
      <div class="code-bar">
        <div class="dots"><span class="dr"></span><span class="dy"></span><span class="dg"></span></div>
        <span class="code-file">yolo_picam.py — Complete Annotated Script</span>
        <button class="cpbtn" onclick="copyCode(this)">copy</button>
      </div>
      <div class="code-body">
<pre><span class="kw">import</span> cv2
<span class="kw">import</span> time
<span class="kw">from</span> ultralytics <span class="kw">import</span> YOLO
<span class="kw">from</span> picamera2 <span class="kw">import</span> Picamera2

<span class="cm"># ── LOAD MODEL ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────</span>
<span class="cm"># Pass the FOLDER path — NCNN format lives in a directory, not a single file</span>
<span class="cm"># task="detect" is REQUIRED for NCNN — YOLO cannot auto-infer from folder format</span>
<span class="fn">print</span>(<span class="st">"Loading YOLO model..."</span>)
model = <span class="fn">YOLO</span>(<span class="st">"yolo11n_ncnn_model"</span>, task=<span class="st">"detect"</span>)

<span class="cm"># ── SETUP CAMERA ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────</span>
<span class="cm"># PiCamera2 talks to the camera hardware via libcamera (modern Linux camera stack)</span>
<span class="cm"># Default output format is RGB888 — NOT BGR. This matters in the loop below.</span>
picam2 = <span class="fn">Picamera2</span>()
picam2.<span class="fn">configure</span>(
    picam2.<span class="fn">create_preview_configuration</span>(main={<span class="st">"size"</span>: (<span class="nu">640</span>, <span class="nu">480</span>)})
)
picam2.<span class="fn">start</span>()
<span class="fn">print</span>(<span class="st">"Camera started"</span>)

prev_time = time.<span class="fn">time</span>()

<span class="cm"># ── DETECTION LOOP ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────</span>
<span class="kw">while</span> <span class="va">True</span>:
    <span class="cm"># Returns HxWx3 NumPy array in RGB order (480, 640, 3)</span>
    frame = picam2.<span class="fn">capture_array</span>()

    <span class="cm"># CRITICAL: Swap R and B channels</span>
    <span class="cm"># PiCamera2 → RGB.  OpenCV / YOLO → BGR.  Wrong order = wrong colours + lower accuracy</span>
    frame = cv2.<span class="fn">cvtColor</span>(frame, cv2.COLOR_RGB2BGR)

    <span class="cm"># Run YOLO — imgsz=640 letterboxes to model's training resolution</span>
    <span class="cm">#            conf=0.3 filters detections below 30% confidence</span>
    results = <span class="fn">model</span>(frame, imgsz=<span class="nu">640</span>, conf=<span class="nu">0.3</span>)

    <span class="cm"># plot() draws all bounding boxes + labels onto a BGR copy of the frame</span>
    frame = results[<span class="nu">0</span>].<span class="fn">plot</span>()

    <span class="cm"># Wall-clock FPS: includes capture + inference + display overhead</span>
    now = time.<span class="fn">time</span>()
    fps = <span class="nu">1</span> / (now - prev_time)
    prev_time = now
    cv2.<span class="fn">putText</span>(frame, <span class="fn">f</span><span class="st">"FPS: {fps:.2f}"</span>, (<span class="nu">10</span>, <span class="nu">30</span>),
                cv2.FONT_HERSHEY_SIMPLEX, <span class="nu">1</span>, (<span class="nu">0</span>, <span class="nu">255</span>, <span class="nu">0</span>), <span class="nu">2</span>)

    cv2.<span class="fn">imshow</span>(<span class="st">"YOLO Detection"</span>, frame)

    <span class="cm"># waitKey(1): poll GUI for 1ms. & 0xFF: 64-bit key-code mask for correct reading</span>
    <span class="kw">if</span> cv2.<span class="fn">waitKey</span>(<span class="nu">1</span>) &amp; <span class="nu">0xFF</span> == <span class="fn">ord</span>(<span class="st">"q"</span>):
        <span class="kw">break</span>

cv2.<span class="fn">destroyAllWindows</span>()</pre>
      </div>
    </div>

    <h3 style="font-size:19px;font-weight:700;color:var(--white);margin:38px 0 14px;letter-spacing:-0.01em">Critical Lines — If You Remove These, Things Break</h3>
    <table class="tbl">
      <thead><tr><th>Line</th><th>What It Does</th><th>Failure Without It</th></tr></thead>
      <tbody>
        <tr><td><code>task="detect"</code></td><td>Explicitly tells YOLO what task — required for non-.pt formats</td><td>ValueError: task must be explicitly provided</td></tr>
        <tr><td><code>cv2.COLOR_RGB2BGR</code></td><td>Swaps index 0 (R) with index 2 (B) in the pixel array</td><td>Red objects appear blue; detection accuracy drops silently</td></tr>
        <tr><td><code>imgsz=640</code></td><td>Letterboxes input to 640×640 — YOLO's training resolution</td><td>Scale mismatch; small object accuracy drops significantly</td></tr>
        <tr><td><code>conf=0.3</code></td><td>Non-Maximum Suppression confidence threshold</td><td>Noisy detections at default 0.25; tune per environment</td></tr>
        <tr><td><code>results[0].plot()</code></td><td>Draws all bboxes + labels onto a new BGR NumPy array</td><td>results[0] is an object, not an image — imshow breaks</td></tr>
        <tr><td><code>waitKey(1) &amp; 0xFF</code></td><td>1ms GUI event loop + 64-bit key mask</td><td>waitKey(0) blocks forever; missing mask → 'q' never registers</td></tr>
      </tbody>
    </table>

    <div class="box box-purple" style="margin-top:28px">
      <div class="box-ico">🔬</div>
      <div class="box-c">
        <div class="box-label">Inspect the Raw Results Object</div>
        <p>After inference, try printing these: <code>results[0].boxes.xyxy</code> (bounding box coordinates as tensor), <code>results[0].boxes.cls</code> (class IDs), <code>results[0].boxes.conf</code> (confidence scores). Everything <code>plot()</code> draws comes from these tensors. Understanding this unlocks every design challenge.</p>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<div class="divider"></div>

<!-- ═══ SECTION 5: PERFORMANCE ═══ -->
<section class="sec" id="perf">
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="sec-tag">Topic 05</div>
    <h2 class="sec-h">Performance Analysis</h2>
    <p class="sec-lead">Knowing where time is spent tells you what can and cannot be optimised.</p>

    <div class="panel" style="margin-bottom:28px">
      <div style="font-size:16px;font-weight:700;color:var(--white);margin-bottom:24px">Frame Time Breakdown · RPi 4 · ~220ms per frame ≈ 4.5 FPS</div>

      <div class="pbar-row">
        <div class="pbar-meta"><span class="pbar-name">YOLO NCNN Inference</span><span class="pbar-val">~170ms · 75%</span></div>
        <div class="pbar-track"><div class="pbar-fill" style="width:75%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#1a56db,#3b82f6)"></div></div>
        <div class="pbar-sub">Hardware-bound bottleneck. Reduce via smaller imgsz or frame skipping.</div>
      </div>
      <div class="pbar-row">
        <div class="pbar-meta"><span class="pbar-name">Camera Capture (PiCamera2)</span><span class="pbar-val">~20ms · 9%</span></div>
        <div class="pbar-track"><div class="pbar-fill" style="width:9%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#059669,#10b981)"></div></div>
        <div class="pbar-sub">Hardware limit — cannot be reduced in software.</div>
      </div>
      <div class="pbar-row">
        <div class="pbar-meta"><span class="pbar-name">results[0].plot() Drawing</span><span class="pbar-val">~20ms · 9%</span></div>
        <div class="pbar-track"><div class="pbar-fill" style="width:9%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#d97706,#f59e0b)"></div></div>
        <div class="pbar-sub">Skip and draw manually with cv2.rectangle for a small FPS gain.</div>
      </div>
      <div class="pbar-row">
        <div class="pbar-meta"><span class="pbar-name">cv2.imshow + waitKey</span><span class="pbar-val">~7ms · 3%</span></div>
        <div class="pbar-track"><div class="pbar-fill" style="width:3%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#7c3aed,#a78bfa)"></div></div>
        <div class="pbar-sub">Remove in headless/GPIO-only deployments for +1 FPS.</div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <table class="tbl">
      <thead><tr><th>Optimisation</th><th>Code Change</th><th>Expected Gain</th></tr></thead>
      <tbody>
        <tr><td>Smaller input size</td><td><code>model(frame, imgsz=320)</code></td><td>+2–3 FPS (small accuracy loss)</td></tr>
        <tr><td>Skip every 2nd frame</td><td><code>if frame_count % 2 == 0: results = model(...)</code></td><td>Display FPS doubles</td></tr>
        <tr><td>Remove display window</td><td>Delete imshow lines, save to disk or GPIO only</td><td>+1–2 FPS</td></tr>
        <tr><td>Manual bbox drawing</td><td>Use <code>results[0].boxes.xyxy</code> + <code>cv2.rectangle()</code></td><td>+0.5 FPS</td></tr>
        <tr><td>Higher conf threshold</td><td><code>conf=0.6</code></td><td>+0.3 FPS (fewer NMS ops)</td></tr>
        <tr><td>Upgrade to Pi 5</td><td>Same code, same model</td><td>~15–20 FPS</td></tr>
      </tbody>
    </table>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- ═══ SECTION 6: TROUBLESHOOT ═══ -->
<section class="sec" id="trouble">
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="sec-tag">Topic 06</div>
    <h2 class="sec-h">Troubleshooting Guide</h2>
    <p class="sec-lead">Common errors, root causes, and exact fixes. Click each error to expand.</p>

    <div id="acc">
      <div class="acc-item">
        <div class="acc-hd" onclick="tog(this)"><span class="acc-err">ImportError: No module named 'picamera2'</span><span class="acc-arrow">▼</span></div>
        <div class="acc-bd">
          <div class="acc-cause">Root cause: Virtual environment was created <strong>without</strong> <code>--system-site-packages</code>. picamera2 requires libcamera native libraries — it cannot be pip-installed.</div>
          <div class="acc-fix">Fix: Delete the venv and recreate correctly:<br/><code>rm -rf venv</code> → <code>python3 -m venv --system-site-packages venv</code> → <code>source venv/bin/activate</code> → reinstall: <code>pip install ultralytics ncnn</code></div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="acc-item">
        <div class="acc-hd" onclick="tog(this)"><span class="acc-err">ValueError: task must be explicitly provided for NCNN</span><span class="acc-arrow">▼</span></div>
        <div class="acc-bd">
          <div class="acc-cause">Root cause: YOLO auto-infers task from a .pt file header. NCNN folder format has no such metadata — you must specify it manually.</div>
          <div class="acc-fix">Fix: <code>model = YOLO("yolo11n_ncnn_model", task="detect")</code></div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="acc-item">
        <div class="acc-hd" onclick="tog(this)"><span class="acc-err">No cameras available / libcamera error</span><span class="acc-arrow">▼</span></div>
        <div class="acc-bd">
          <div class="acc-cause">Root cause: Camera hardware not detected. Ribbon cable is loose, wrong orientation, or the Pi wasn't rebooted after a camera stack update.</div>
          <div class="acc-fix">Fix: <code>sudo shutdown now</code> → re-seat ribbon cable with silver contacts facing HDMI port → power on → retest with <code>rpicam-hello</code>. Do NOT enable Legacy Camera in raspi-config on Bookworm.</div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="acc-item">
        <div class="acc-hd" onclick="tog(this)"><span class="acc-err">Colours inverted — red objects appear blue</span><span class="acc-arrow">▼</span></div>
        <div class="acc-bd">
          <div class="acc-cause">Root cause: Missing RGB→BGR conversion. PiCamera2 outputs RGB (R=channel 0). YOLO expects BGR (B=channel 0). Channels are swapped in every pixel.</div>
          <div class="acc-fix">Fix: Add after <code>capture_array()</code>: <code>frame = cv2.cvtColor(frame, cv2.COLOR_RGB2BGR)</code></div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="acc-item">
        <div class="acc-hd" onclick="tog(this)"><span class="acc-err">Detection window opens and closes immediately</span><span class="acc-arrow">▼</span></div>
        <div class="acc-bd">
          <div class="acc-cause">Root cause: <code>cv2.imshow()</code> requires <code>waitKey()</code> in the same loop iteration to render. Without it, OpenCV has no GUI event loop and the window disappears instantly.</div>
          <div class="acc-fix">Fix: Ensure <code>cv2.waitKey(1)</code> is inside the while loop, <em>after</em> every <code>imshow()</code> call.</div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="acc-item">
        <div class="acc-hd" onclick="tog(this)"><span class="acc-err">FPS shows 0.1 or 1.0 — inference extremely slow</span><span class="acc-arrow">▼</span></div>
        <div class="acc-bd">
          <div class="acc-cause">Root cause: Loading the .pt PyTorch model instead of the NCNN folder. PyTorch inference on ARM Pi is 10× slower than NCNN.</div>
          <div class="acc-fix">Fix: Change model path from <code>"yolo11n.pt"</code> to <code>"yolo11n_ncnn_model"</code> (the folder). Verify it exists: <code>ls yolo11n_ncnn_model</code></div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="acc-item">
        <div class="acc-hd" onclick="tog(this)"><span class="acc-err">ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'ultralytics'</span><span class="acc-arrow">▼</span></div>
        <div class="acc-bd">
          <div class="acc-cause">Root cause: pip install ran outside the venv — packages installed to system Python instead of the venv Python.</div>
          <div class="acc-fix">Fix: <code>cd ~/yolo</code> → <code>source venv/bin/activate</code> → <code>pip install ultralytics ncnn</code>. Confirm venv active: prompt shows <code>(venv)</code>.</div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="acc-item">
        <div class="acc-hd" onclick="tog(this)"><span class="acc-err">cv2.imshow crashes over SSH / black screen</span><span class="acc-arrow">▼</span></div>
        <div class="acc-bd">
          <div class="acc-cause">Root cause: No display environment over SSH. OpenCV's imshow requires an X11 or Wayland context to render a window.</div>
          <div class="acc-fix">Options: (1) Enable VNC, connect via VNC Viewer, run script there. (2) <code>DISPLAY=:0 python yolo_picam.py</code>. (3) Remove imshow — save frames to disk instead: replace with <code>cv2.imwrite(f"frame_{count}.jpg", frame)</code></div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<div class="divider"></div>

<section class="sec" id="coco">
  <div class="wrap">

    <h2 class="sec-h">COCO Dataset — 80 Detectable Classes</h2>
    <p class="sec-lead">YOLO11n is trained on COCO (Common Objects in Context). These are the object types it recognises out of the box.</p>

    <div class="coco-grid">
      <div class="coco-card"><div class="coco-ico">🧍</div><div class="coco-title">People & Vehicles</div><div class="coco-list">person (0) · bicycle (1) · car (2) · motorcycle (3) · airplane (4) · bus (5) · train (6) · truck (7) · boat (8)</div></div>
      <div class="coco-card"><div class="coco-ico">🐕</div><div class="coco-title">Animals</div><div class="coco-list">bird (14) · cat (15) · dog (16) · horse (17) · sheep (18) · cow (19) · elephant (20) · bear (21) · zebra (22) · giraffe (23)</div></div>
      <div class="coco-card"><div class="coco-ico">💻</div><div class="coco-title">Electronics</div><div class="coco-list">tv (62) · laptop (63) · mouse (64) · remote (65) · keyboard (66) · cell phone (67) · microwave (68) · oven (69)</div></div>
      <div class="coco-card"><div class="coco-ico">🍎</div><div class="coco-title">Food & Kitchen</div><div class="coco-list">bottle (39) · wine glass (40) · cup (41) · fork (42) · knife (43) · spoon (44) · bowl (45) · banana (46) · apple (47) · pizza (53) · cake (55)</div></div>
      <div class="coco-card"><div class="coco-ico">🪑</div><div class="coco-title">Furniture & Indoor</div><div class="coco-list">chair (56) · couch (57) · potted plant (58) · bed (59) · dining table (60) · toilet (61) · sink (75) · refrigerator (72)</div></div>
      <div class="coco-card"><div class="coco-ico">🎒</div><div class="coco-title">Personal Items</div><div class="coco-list">backpack (24) · umbrella (25) · handbag (26) · suitcase (28) · book (73) · clock (74) · vase (75) · scissors (76) · toothbrush (79)</div></div>
    </div>

    <div class="box box-info" style="margin-top:24px">
      <div class="box-ico">📊</div>
      <div class="box-c">
        <div class="box-label">Access Class Names in Code</div>
        <p><code>model.names</code> returns a dict like <code>{0: 'person', 1: 'bicycle', ...}</code>. To filter detections to a specific class: <code>if int(box.cls.item()) == 0:  # person</code>. To get the class name: <code>model.names[int(box.cls.item())]</code>. This is the foundation of Design Challenges 1 and 2.</p>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- ═══ SECTION 8: DESIGN CHALLENGES ═══ -->
<section class="ch-section sec" id="challenges">
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="sec-tag">Design Challenges</div>
    <h2 class="sec-h">Now Build Something Real</h2>
    <p class="sec-lead" style="margin-bottom:16px">Seven engineering challenges that extend the base YOLO script. Each one teaches a different real-world skill. Complete them in order — each one builds on what you learned in the last.</p>

    <div class="box box-gold" style="margin-bottom:40px">
      <div class="box-ico">🎯</div>
      <div class="box-c">
        <div class="box-label">Before You Start Any Challenge</div>
        <p>Make a copy of the base script first: <code>cp yolo_picam.py yolo_ch1.py</code>. Work on the copy — keep your original clean. Read the entire challenge description before writing any code. Then look at the hint only if you're stuck for more than 15 minutes.</p>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="ch-grid">

      <!-- C1 -->
      <div class="ch-card">
        <div class="ch-top">
          <div class="ch-badge">01</div>
          <div class="ch-diff"><span class="star">★</span><span class="star">★</span><span class="star off">★</span><span class="star off">★</span>&nbsp;Beginner</div>
        </div>
        <div class="ch-title">Person Counter with HUD Overlay</div>
        <div class="ch-desc">Modify the detection script so it <strong>only displays</strong> detections of the "person" class (ID 0). Count how many people are visible in each frame and draw the count as a bold overlay in the top-right corner. When count is 0, show green text. When count is 1+, show red text.</div>
        <div class="ch-tags">
          <span class="ct ct-b">results.boxes.cls</span>
          <span class="ct ct-g">cv2.putText</span>
          <span class="ct ct-o">Class Filtering</span>
        </div>
        <div class="ch-hint"><strong>Hint:</strong> Iterate <code>results[0].boxes</code>. Each box has <code>.cls</code> (class ID tensor). Use <code>int(box.cls.item()) == 0</code> to check for persons. Count them. Use <code>cv2.rectangle()</code> and <code>cv2.putText()</code> to draw manually instead of <code>plot()</code>. Get coordinates from <code>box.xyxy[0].tolist()</code>.</div>
      </div>

      <!-- C2 -->
      <div class="ch-card">
        <div class="ch-top">
          <div class="ch-badge">02</div>
          <div class="ch-diff"><span class="star">★</span><span class="star">★</span><span class="star off">★</span><span class="star off">★</span>&nbsp;Beginner</div>
        </div>
        <div class="ch-title">GPIO LED Alert on Object Detection</div>
        <div class="ch-desc">Connect an LED to GPIO pin 17 (330Ω resistor to ground). Make the LED <strong>turn ON</strong> whenever a bottle (class 39) is detected with confidence &gt; 0.6. Turn it OFF when no bottle is visible. This is the foundation of all real robotics: vision triggering physical action.</div>
        <div class="ch-tags">
          <span class="ct ct-b">gpiozero.LED</span>
          <span class="ct ct-g">results.boxes.conf</span>
          <span class="ct ct-o">GPIO Integration</span>
        </div>
        <div class="ch-hint"><strong>Hint:</strong> <code>from gpiozero import LED; led = LED(17)</code>. In the detection loop, check if any box has <code>cls==39</code> AND <code>conf&gt;0.6</code>. If yes: <code>led.on()</code>. Else: <code>led.off()</code>. Handle <code>KeyboardInterrupt</code> to clean up GPIO on exit with a <code>try/finally</code> block.</div>
      </div>

      <!-- C3 -->
      <div class="ch-card">
        <div class="ch-top">
          <div class="ch-badge">03</div>
          <div class="ch-diff"><span class="star">★</span><span class="star">★</span><span class="star">★</span><span class="star off">★</span>&nbsp;Intermediate</div>
        </div>
        <div class="ch-title">Real-Time Detection Logger to CSV</div>
        <div class="ch-desc">Log every detection event to a CSV file. Each row: <strong>timestamp, class name, confidence, x1, y1, x2, y2</strong>. After 60 seconds of running, open the CSV and analyse: which class appears most? What is the average confidence per class? Create a simple bar chart of detection counts using matplotlib.</div>
        <div class="ch-tags">
          <span class="ct ct-b">csv module</span>
          <span class="ct ct-g">datetime</span>
          <span class="ct ct-o">results.boxes.xyxy</span>
          <span class="ct ct-p">matplotlib</span>
        </div>
        <div class="ch-hint"><strong>Hint:</strong> <code>import csv, datetime</code>. Open file with <code>open('log.csv','a',newline='')</code>. For each box: <code>xyxy = box.xyxy[0].tolist()</code>, <code>conf = float(box.conf.item())</code>, <code>cls_name = model.names[int(box.cls.item())]</code>, timestamp = <code>datetime.datetime.now().isoformat()</code>. Write one row per detection per frame.</div>
      </div>

      <!-- C4 -->
      <div class="ch-card">
        <div class="ch-top">
          <div class="ch-badge">04</div>
          <div class="ch-diff"><span class="star">★</span><span class="star">★</span><span class="star">★</span><span class="star off">★</span>&nbsp;Intermediate</div>
        </div>
        <div class="ch-title">Danger Zone Intrusion Detector</div>
        <div class="ch-desc">Draw a fixed <strong>restricted zone</strong> rectangle in the centre of the frame (e.g. coords 200,150 → 440,330). When any detected object's bounding box overlaps with the zone: zone border turns red, text flashes "⚠ INTRUSION". When clear: zone border is green. This is used in factory floor safety systems.</div>
        <div class="ch-tags">
          <span class="ct ct-b">Overlap Detection</span>
          <span class="ct ct-g">cv2.rectangle</span>
          <span class="ct ct-r">Safety Logic</span>
        </div>
        <div class="ch-hint"><strong>Hint:</strong> Two rectangles overlap when: <code>x1_a &lt; x2_b AND x2_a &gt; x1_b AND y1_a &lt; y2_b AND y2_a &gt; y1_b</code>. Define your zone as fixed coords. Loop through <code>results[0].boxes.xyxy</code>. Check overlap. Draw the zone AFTER <code>results[0].plot()</code> so the zone overlays the detection boxes.</div>
      </div>

      <!-- C5 -->
      <div class="ch-card">
        <div class="ch-top">
          <div class="ch-badge">05</div>
          <div class="ch-diff"><span class="star">★</span><span class="star">★</span><span class="star">★</span><span class="star">★</span>&nbsp;Advanced</div>
        </div>
        <div class="ch-title">Frame-Skip Optimisation Analyser</div>
        <div class="ch-desc">Add a configurable frame-skip parameter N. When N=1 detect every frame. When N=2 detect every 2nd frame (show last result on skipped frames). Run 30 seconds at N=1,2,3,4. Record average FPS at each. Plot <strong>FPS vs N</strong> using matplotlib and analyse the trade-off: at what N does accuracy visibly degrade while watching the feed?</div>
        <div class="ch-tags">
          <span class="ct ct-b">time.time()</span>
          <span class="ct ct-g">matplotlib</span>
          <span class="ct ct-o">Optimisation</span>
          <span class="ct ct-p">Analysis</span>
        </div>
        <div class="ch-hint"><strong>Hint:</strong> <code>frame_count = 0</code>. In loop: <code>if frame_count % N == 0: results = model(...)</code>. Always render: <code>frame = results[0].plot()</code>. Track <code>fps_list.append(fps)</code>. Analyse: <code>print(f"Avg FPS at N={N}: {sum(fps_list)/len(fps_list):.2f}")</code>. Run 4 separate sessions and compare.</div>
      </div>

      <!-- C6 -->
      <div class="ch-card">
        <div class="ch-top">
          <div class="ch-badge">06</div>
          <div class="ch-diff"><span class="star">★</span><span class="star">★</span><span class="star">★</span><span class="star">★</span>&nbsp;Advanced</div>
        </div>
        <div class="ch-title">Persistent Object Tracker with IDs</div>
        <div class="ch-desc">Assign each detected object a unique ID based on centroid proximity. If a detection in frame N is within 50px (Euclidean) of a detection in frame N-1, it's the same object — keep its ID. Remove IDs not seen for 5+ frames. Display the ID and frame count next to each detection label. This is the core algorithm behind real object trackers.</div>
        <div class="ch-tags">
          <span class="ct ct-b">Object Tracking</span>
          <span class="ct ct-g">Euclidean Distance</span>
          <span class="ct ct-p">State Management</span>
          <span class="ct ct-r">Advanced</span>
        </div>
        <div class="ch-hint"><strong>Hint:</strong> Maintain <code>tracked = {id: {centroid, last_frame, cls}}</code>. Compute centroid of each new detection: <code>cx=(x1+x2)/2, cy=(y1+y2)/2</code>. Match to nearest existing centroid within threshold using <code>math.sqrt((cx-tx)**2+(cy-ty)**2)</code>. Assign existing ID if match found, new ID (auto-incrementing counter) if not. Prune stale tracks each frame.</div>
      </div>

      <!-- C7 CAPSTONE -->
      <div class="ch-card ch-capstone">
        <div class="ch-top">
          <div class="ch-badge" style="background:rgba(233,184,74,.18);border-color:rgba(233,184,74,.4);font-size:12px">07</div>
          <div class="ch-diff" style="color:var(--gold)"><span class="star">★</span><span class="star">★</span><span class="star">★</span><span class="star">★</span>&nbsp;🏆 Capstone</div>
        </div>
        <div class="ch-title" style="font-size:19px;color:var(--gold2)">Smart Surveillance System</div>
        <div class="ch-desc">Combine everything you've learned into a complete embedded CV application. Your system must:<br/><br/>
          <strong style="color:var(--white)">1.</strong> Run live YOLO detection at maximum speed<br/>
          <strong style="color:var(--white)">2.</strong> Display a real-time sidebar showing count of each detected class<br/>
          <strong style="color:var(--white)">3.</strong> Trigger a GPIO output when person count exceeds a configurable threshold<br/>
          <strong style="color:var(--white)">4.</strong> Log all detections with timestamps to CSV continuously<br/>
          <strong style="color:var(--white)">5.</strong> Show FPS + total detections as a HUD overlay<br/>
          <strong style="color:var(--white)">6.</strong> Support keyboard commands: <strong>R</strong> = reset counts, <strong>S</strong> = save screenshot, <strong>Q</strong> = quit<br/><br/>
          Document every function with a docstring explaining what it does and why. This is a production-ready embedded system.
        </div>
        <div class="ch-tags">
          <span class="ct ct-b">Full Integration</span>
          <span class="ct ct-g">GPIO + Vision</span>
          <span class="ct ct-o">CSV Logging</span>
          <span class="ct ct-p">HUD Overlay</span>
          <span class="ct ct-r">Keyboard Controls</span>
        </div>
        <div class="ch-hint" style="background:rgba(233,184,74,.07);border-color:rgba(233,184,74,.2)">
          <strong>Architecture hint:</strong> Split into clean functions — <code>draw_hud(frame, fps, counts)</code>, <code>log_event(writer, boxes, names)</code>, <code>check_alert(counts, threshold, led)</code>, <code>handle_key(key, frame, counts)</code>. Keep your main detection loop to 10 lines max — all logic lives in functions. This is professional code structure.
        </div>
      </div>

    </div><!-- end ch-grid -->

<script>
// PROGRESS
window.addEventListener('scroll',()=>{
  const p=window.scrollY/(document.documentElement.scrollHeight-window.innerHeight);
  document.getElementById('bar').style.width=(p*100)+'%';
});

// NAV ACTIVE
const secs=[...document.querySelectorAll('section[id]')];
const links=[...document.querySelectorAll('nav a')];
new IntersectionObserver(entries=>{
  entries.forEach(e=>{
    if(e.isIntersecting){
      links.forEach(l=>l.classList.remove('on'));
      const a=document.querySelector(`nav a[href="#${e.target.id}"]`);
      if(a)a.classList.add('on');
    }
  });
},{threshold:0.3}).observe;
secs.forEach(s=>new IntersectionObserver(entries=>{
  entries.forEach(e=>{if(e.isIntersecting){links.forEach(l=>l.classList.remove('on'));const a=document.querySelector(`nav a[href="#${e.target.id}"]`);if(a)a.classList.add('on');}  });
},{threshold:0.3}).observe(s));

// ACCORDION
function tog(hd){
  const item=hd.parentElement;
  const was=item.classList.contains('open');
  document.querySelectorAll('.acc-item.open').forEach(i=>i.classList.remove('open'));
  if(!was)item.classList.add('open');
}

// COPY
function copyCode(btn){
  const pre=btn.closest('.code-wrap').querySelector('pre');
  navigator.clipboard.writeText(pre.innerText).then(()=>{
    btn.textContent='✓ copied';
    btn.style.color='#34d399';
    setTimeout(()=>{btn.textContent='copy';btn.style.color=''},1800);
  });
}
</script>
